facts.fact: The Kenny Patton real estate CTV case study was published on May 27, 2025.
The original ad in the Kenny Patton case study advertised a Sammamish, WA residential property at $1,260,000, and the page states it is an example and not a current listing.
facts.quote: advertised at $1,260,000, overlooking the eighth tee in Sahalee

facts.fact: The property featured in the original Kenny Patton ad has five bedrooms, three bathrooms, and 2,560 square feet.
facts.quote: five bedrooms, three bathrooms, 2,560 square feet

facts.fact: Adwave states that when a website is entered, it builds ads for TV, search, social, and the web.
facts.quote: Enter your site and Adwave builds ads for TV, search, social, and the web.

facts.fact: Adwave states that analysis of a campaign plan is free and that users can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: The case study advises measuring property inquiries separately from inquiries by sellers looking for an agent when using TV, search, and social.
facts.quote: Measure property inquiries separately from inquiries by sellers looking for an agent.
